observations: Used automatic gearbox with attached starter motor.
Aluminum casing shows heavy surface oxidation and dirt accumulation.
Cut electrical wires are visible near a connector in photo 1.
A dipstick tube with a handle is visible in photo 1, indicating an automatic transmission.
The starter motor has a label with Japanese characters and technical text in photo 1, but the model number is illegible.
Blue paint markings are visible on the casing in photos 0 and 2, common in salvage yards.

risks.if_unproven: Unpriceable, as value depends entirely on the specific vehicle make and year it fits.

risks.proof: A video of the donor vehicle running or a specialist's inspection report.

proof_requests: Photo of the identification tag or stamped model number on the gearbox casing.
Clearer photo of the starter motor label to help identify the engine series.
Photos of the input shaft and torque converter area if separated.
response.reason: The specific model of the gearbox is not visible. Since the market value of a transmission is determined by the vehicle it fits, it is impossible to provide even a worst-case price without identification.
